) DTC Normal I Source Voltage Drop
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The SAS is equipped with a voltage-increase circuit (DC-DC converter) in the airbag sensor assembly in
case the source voltage drops.
When the battery voltage drops, the voltage-increase circuit (DC-DC converter) functions to increase the
voltage of the SAS to normal voltage.
The diagnosis system malfunction display for this circuit is different from other circuits that is when the SAS
waming light remains lit up and the DTC is a normal code, source voltage drop is indicated.
Malfunction in this circuit is not recorded in the airbag sensor assembly, and the source voltage returns to
normal, the SAS warning light automatically goes off.
